item.title: Presidents' Day holiday impacts mail, trash collection, more
item.description: Presidents' Day is a federal holiday observed on February 16, resulting in the closure of banks, government offices, and some schools, while some services such as USPS Priority Mail Express, FedEx, UPS, and COTA buses will remain operational.
